name: WCD
f_name: Women and Child Development & Social Welfare Department

json_data.long: The Women and Child Development & Social Welfare Department oversees programs focused on the welfare of women, children, senior citizens, disabled individuals, and marginalized households. It manages child development services, nutrition programs, Anganwadi centers, adoption processes, and protection schemes. The department also administers pensions, disability support, rehabilitation services, and women empowerment initiatives. Through partnerships with NGOs and district authorities, it ensures effective delivery of welfare benefits. Awareness campaigns, training, and community outreach strengthen gender equality and social protection. Its comprehensive approach makes it central to inclusive development and social welfare in West Bengal.

vision_mission.text: A society where women and children realize their full potential in a safe and supportive environment.

vision_mission.text: To implement policies and programs that promote women's empowerment, child development, and social welfare through strategic interventions and community participation.
vision_mission.title: Mission

json_data.short: This department implements welfare schemes for women, children, elderly persons, and vulnerable groups, focusing on nutrition, protection, empowerment, and social security.
